The test intent is the complete expectation; dialogue supplies evidence, not extra requirements. Do not require incidental names, dates, times, venues or streets absent from the expectation. Resolve relative days from each message's written timestamp where the dialogue makes that clear. Cite exact dialogue source IDs (including any assistant-user: prefix) for each.
